registration: Fixed before execution; no condition severity or test-frame selection after viewing outcomes
source: First 100 chronological frames from each of the same three original UA-DETRAC test sequences
model: Original pretrained YOLO11n, same 640 input, confidence .001 for AP and .25 for precision/recall, IoU .7
scope: Controlled synthetic degradations of real held-out images; not natural night/rain/snow performance or a weather subgroup benchmark
promotion: Evidence and quality warnings only; unchanged default detector. All conditions reported, no augmentation-based robustness claim.
